divisions.headline: Appetite races to huge win if big first step in title chase; Beach (and the Sean Blydenburgh debut) push Jonesing to the brink in 1001; Wing posts minor doubles comeback to sidestep Dart Attack and start the season in the win column
Serious uses a little bit of an '01 edge to squeeze by OnlyDarts; Bottoms outlast the Kids in a tough one to start B on the plus side; Possee has strong night, takes early race lead
Mafia falls behind big early, fights back to tiebreaker win over the Secrets; Projectile jumps out early, hang on late against Pints; Menace and Area climb from D, start out rolling
Rally and Niners each sweep a cricket set, cruise to big wins; Bandits just slowly stroll away from The Bullies; the Knights ride a big cricket edge past Sanchez in a big pairing
E plays out in super close fashion, with only one team surpassing 13 points; What's the Point gets 10 cricket pts on the way to early lead; Dartness pulls one out in the final 501
Two Time rips 11 cricket points from Shooters; She Said keeps pace with solid win over Down to F; Nein Mark digs one out of the fire with a full 501/1001 sweep to escape Cheapies
Rippin sweeps two sets in their race to early G lead; Machine also wins big, setting up an early week 2 showdown; Banging outlasts Flight Club, eventually ending with a solid win
SofaKings (my H title pick) 'welcome' the brand new team in an unfortunate wk01 pairing; Double Vision sweeps 501, shakes off Bright Side; Dirty Darts ride big doubles edge to win
